documentation.content: A backup job or the daily workflow failed. Runbook: docs/operacao/backup.md (ADR 0082).

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = monitoring.regex.full_match("sacou-backup(-test)?") AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"

resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND resource.labels.workflow_id = "sacou-backups" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.labels.status = "FAILED"
